data.falco.yaml:
append_output:
- suggested_output: true
base_syscalls:
  all: false
  custom_set: []
  repair: false
buffer_format_base64: false
buffered_outputs: false
capture:
  default_duration: 5000
  enabled: false
  mode: rules
  path_prefix: /tmp/falco
config_files:
- /etc/falco/config.d
engine:
  kind: modern_ebpf
  modern_ebpf:
    buf_size_preset: 2
    cpus_for_each_buffer: 2
    disable_iterators: false
    drop_failed_exit: false
falco_libs:
  snaplen: 80
  thread_table_auto_purging_interval_s: 300
  thread_table_auto_purging_thread_timeout_s: 300
  thread_table_size: 262144
file_output:
  enabled: false
  filename: ./events.txt
  keep_alive: false
http_output:
  ca_bundle: ""
  ca_cert: ""
  ca_path: /etc/falco/certs/
  client_cert: /etc/falco/certs/client/client.crt
  client_key: /etc/falco/certs/client/client.key
  compress_uploads: false
  echo: false
  enabled: false
  insecure: false
  keep_alive: false
  max_consecutive_timeouts: 5
  mtls: false
  url: ""
  user_agent: falcosecurity/falco
json_include_message_property: false
json_include_output_fields_property: true
json_include_output_property: true
json_include_tags_property: true
json_output: true
libs_logger:
  enabled: true
  severity: info
load_plugins:
- container
log_level: info
log_stderr: true
log_syslog: false
metrics:
  convert_memory_to_mb: true
  enabled: true
  include_empty_values: false
  interval: 30s
  jemalloc_stats_enabled: false
  kernel_event_counters_enabled: true
  kernel_event_counters_per_cpu_enabled: false
  kernel_iter_event_counters_enabled: true
  libbpf_stats_enabled: false
  output_rule: false
  plugins_metrics_enabled: true
  resource_utilization_enabled: true
  rules_counters_enabled: true
  state_counters_enabled: true
output_timeout: 2000
outputs_queue:
  capacity: 0
plugins:
- init_config:
    engines:
      bpm:
        enabled: false
      containerd:
        enabled: false
        sockets:
        - /run/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock
      cri:
        enabled: true
        sockets:
        - /run/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock
      docker:
        enabled: false
        sockets:
        - /var/run/docker.sock
      libvirt_lxc:
        enabled: false
      lxc:
        enabled: false
      podman:
        enabled: false
        sockets:
        - /run/podman/podman.sock
    hooks:
    - create
    label_max_len: 100
    with_size: false
  library_path: libcontainer.so
  name: container
plugins_hostinfo: true
priority: debug
program_output:
  enabled: false
  keep_alive: false
  program: 'jq ''{text: .output}'' | curl -d @- -X POST https://hooks.slack.com/services/XXX'
rule_matching: first
rules_files:
- /etc/falco/rules.d/platform-rules.yaml
stdout_output:
  enabled: true
syscall_event_drops:
  actions:
  - log
  - alert
  max_burst: 1
  rate: 0.03333
  simulate_drops: false
  threshold: 0.1
syscall_event_timeouts:
  max_consecutives: 1000
syslog_output:
  enabled: false
time_format_iso_8601: false
watch_config_files: true
webserver:
  enabled: true
  k8s_healthz_endpoint: /healthz
  listen_address: 0.0.0.0
  listen_port: 8765
  prometheus_metrics_enabled: true
  ssl_certificate: /etc/falco/falco.pem
  ssl_enabled: false
  threadiness: 0

data.platform-rules.yaml:
- list: platform_runtime_namespaces
  items:
  - petclinic
  - devsecops-test
- macro: platform_runtime_scope
  condition: container.id != host and k8s.ns.name in (platform_runtime_namespaces)
- macro: platform_expected_runtime_bootstrap
  condition: proc.exepath="/var/lib/rancher/k3s/data/876326f0487c64e27190fea8c8c5f54263aabc782061df6455fa54c0f7e2a1ad/bin/runc"
    and proc.name in ("runc:[0:PARENT]", "runc:[1:CHILD]") and proc.cmdline in ("runc:[0:PARENT]
    init", "runc:[1:CHILD] init", "runc:[1:CHILD]") and ((k8s.ns.name=petclinic and
    container.name in (worker, tests) and container.image.repository="192.168.1.58:30050/platform-upgrade/airflow")
    or (k8s.ns.name=petclinic and container.name=petclinic and container.image.repository="core.harbor.domain/petclinic/petclinic")
    or (k8s.ns.name=devsecops-test and container.name=test and container.image.repository="127.0.0.1:30050/petclinic/petclinic"))
- rule: Platform Runtime Shell
  desc: Shell start in business or isolated security test namespace; an expected operator
    exec is still auditable.
  condition: platform_runtime_scope and (evt.type in (execve, execveat) and evt.failed=false
    and proc.name in (sh, bash, dash, ash)) and not (k8s.ns.name=petclinic and container.name=worker
    and container.image.repository="192.168.1.58:30050/platform-upgrade/airflow" and
    proc.name=sh and proc.cmdline="sh -c kill -0 1") and not (k8s.ns.name=petclinic
    and container.name=petclinic and container.image.repository="core.harbor.domain/petclinic/petclinic"
    and proc.exepath="/usr/bin/dash" and proc.name=sh and proc.cmdline="sh -c sleep
    5")
  output: runtime_security node=%evt.hostname namespace=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name
    container=%container.name image=%container.image.repository process=%proc.name
    command=%proc.cmdline user=%user.uid result=%evt.res executable=%proc.exepath
    syscall=%evt.type
  priority: WARNING
  tags:
  - platform_runtime
  - container
- rule: Platform Runtime Sensitive Read
  desc: Sensitive identity file read, including denied attempt; classify libc lookup
    noise from observed evidence.
  condition: (platform_runtime_scope and (evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and
    evt.is_open_read=true and evt.arg.name in (/etc/shadow, /etc/passwd))) and not
    platform_expected_runtime_bootstrap
  output: runtime_security node=%evt.hostname namespace=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name
    container=%container.name image=%container.image.repository process=%proc.name
    command=%proc.cmdline user=%user.uid result=%evt.res executable=%proc.exepath
    syscall=%evt.type
  priority: WARNING
  tags:
  - platform_runtime
  - container
- rule: Platform Runtime Package Manager
  desc: Package manager execution; tests use --version, never install software.
  condition: platform_runtime_scope and (evt.type in (execve, execveat) and evt.failed=false
    and proc.name in (apt, apt-get, yum, dnf, apk))
  output: runtime_security node=%evt.hostname namespace=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name
    container=%container.name image=%container.image.repository process=%proc.name
    command=%proc.cmdline user=%user.uid result=%evt.res executable=%proc.exepath
    syscall=%evt.type
  priority: WARNING
  tags:
  - platform_runtime
  - container
- rule: Platform Runtime Network Utility
  desc: Network utility execution, not proof of network exfiltration; tests use --help
    only.
  condition: platform_runtime_scope and (evt.type in (execve, execveat) and evt.failed=false
    and proc.name in (nc, ncat, netcat, socat))
  output: runtime_security node=%evt.hostname namespace=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name
    container=%container.name image=%container.image.repository process=%proc.name
    command=%proc.cmdline user=%user.uid result=%evt.res executable=%proc.exepath
    syscall=%evt.type
  priority: WARNING
  tags:
  - platform_runtime
  - container
- rule: Platform Runtime HTTP Utility
  desc: HTTP utility is visibility, not automatically an attack. Expected use is reviewed
    by exact workload and command.
  condition: platform_runtime_scope and (evt.type in (execve, execveat) and evt.failed=false
    and proc.name in (curl, wget))
  output: runtime_security node=%evt.hostname namespace=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name
    container=%container.name image=%container.image.repository process=%proc.name
    command=%proc.cmdline user=%user.uid result=%evt.res executable=%proc.exepath
    syscall=%evt.type
  priority: NOTICE
  tags:
  - platform_runtime
  - container
- rule: Platform Runtime Namespace Or Mount
  desc: Container namespace/mount operation or tool, including unsuccessful attempts.
    Not proof of an escape.
  condition: (platform_runtime_scope and (evt.type in (mount, setns, unshare) or (evt.type
    in (execve, execveat) and proc.name in (mount, nsenter)))) and not platform_expected_runtime_bootstrap
  output: runtime_security node=%evt.hostname namespace=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name
    container=%container.name image=%container.image.repository process=%proc.name
    command=%proc.cmdline user=%user.uid result=%evt.res executable=%proc.exepath
    syscall=%evt.type
  priority: ERROR
  tags:
  - platform_runtime
  - container
- rule: Platform Runtime Privilege
  desc: Execution in a privileged container or capability change syscall; no privileged
    tests are created.
  condition: (platform_runtime_scope and ((evt.type in (execve, execveat) and evt.failed=false
    and container.privileged=true) or evt.type=capset)) and not platform_expected_runtime_bootstrap
  output: runtime_security node=%evt.hostname namespace=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name
    container=%container.name image=%container.image.repository process=%proc.name
    command=%proc.cmdline user=%user.uid result=%evt.res executable=%proc.exepath
    syscall=%evt.type
  priority: ERROR
  tags:
  - platform_runtime
  - container
- rule: Platform Runtime Sensitive Write
  desc: Attempt to write protected system paths, including readonly denial; never
    treated as a successful mutation without syscall result.
  condition: platform_runtime_scope and (evt.type in (open, openat, openat2, creat)
    and (evt.arg.flags contains O_WRONLY or evt.arg.flags contains O_RDWR or evt.arg.flags
    contains O_CREAT) and (evt.arg.name startswith /etc/ or evt.arg.name startswith
    /usr/bin/ or evt.arg.name startswith /usr/sbin/ or evt.arg.name startswith /bin/
    or evt.arg.name startswith /sbin/))
  output: runtime_security node=%evt.hostname namespace=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name
    container=%container.name image=%container.image.repository process=%proc.name
    command=%proc.cmdline user=%user.uid result=%evt.res executable=%proc.exepath
    syscall=%evt.type
  priority: ERROR
  tags:
  - platform_runtime
  - container
